Disables and checks GRO and GRE offloads on the main and loopback interfaces for AF_XDP.

# Purpose
This file defines a configuration stage named `ethtool-offloads` for network setup. It runs only when the network provider is `xdp` and the system is not using a network namespace. The stage disables ethtool features that conflict with AF_XDP use: generic receive offload on the target interface and on `lo`, plus `tx-gre-segmentation` and `tx-gre-csum-segmentation`. It also handles bonded interfaces by detecting a bond under `/sys/class/net/<device>/bonding` and applying the settings to each slave device instead of the bond device itself.

The file also provides validation logic for the same devices. The [`check`](<#check>) path reads the current ethtool state and reports an error if any of the required offloads remain enabled. The stage is exposed through the `configure_stage_t fd_cfg_stage_ethtool_offloads` object, which supplies the stage name, permission setup, initialization, and verification hooks used by the wider configuration system.
